enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Finesse : This weapon has a Small air elemental bound to it. The wielder can use a finesse weapon as if he had the Weapon Finesse feat. In addition, the weapon grants a +2 enhancement bonus to the wielder's Dexterity score.
True Chaos: This weapon is infused with the power of True Chaos. It does an additional 1 to 6 damage to non-chaotic targets and can only be wielded by Chaotic-aligned characters.
